description: Repository class for managing feature flags and feature access control, implementing IFeaturesRepository interface, with methods for retrieving, checking, and updating feature flags for users, teams, and globally. Uses Prisma ORM and includes caching and recursive SQL queries for hierarchy checks.

classes.name: FeaturesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing feature flags and feature access control, implementing IFeaturesRepository interface.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves all features with caching to avoid frequent database hits.

methods.name: getFeatureFlagMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all feature flags and their enabled status.

methods.name: getEnabledTeamFeatures
methods.description: Gets all features enabled for a specific team.

methods.name: checkIfFeatureIsEnabledGlobally
methods.description: Checks if a feature is globally enabled.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a user has access to a feature, considering user and team assignments.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasFeatureNonHierarchical
methods.description: Checks user feature access without hierarchy traversal.

methods.name: checkIfUserBelongsToTeamWithFeature
methods.description: Private helper to check if user belongs to a team with a feature, using recursive SQL.

methods.name: checkIfUserBelongsToTeamWithFeatureNonHierarchical
methods.description: Private helper to check direct team membership with feature, ignoring hierarchy.

methods.name: setUserFeatureState
methods.description: Updates user feature state with tri-state semantics.

methods.name: setTeamFeatureState
methods.description: Updates team feature state with tri-state semantics.

methods.name: checkIfTeamHasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a team or its ancestors have a feature enabled using recursive SQL.

methods.name: getTeamsWithFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Returns list of team IDs where a feature is enabled, considering global enablement.
